description: This Java class 'TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer' implements an 'Enforcer' interface to create and manage a policy tree for access control, perform policy checks, and generate JSON views based on permissions within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer
classes.description: Implements policy enforcement logic, including creation of policy trees, permission checks, and JSON view generation within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: PointerAndValue
classes.description: Immutable wrapper holding a JsonPointer and its associated JsonValue.

classes.name: PointerAndPermission
classes.description: Immutable wrapper holding a JsonPointer and a permission string.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new TreeBasedPolicyEnforcer instance from a given Policy object.

methods.name: addResourceSubTree
methods.description: Recursively adds resources and permissions to the policy tree based on resource paths.

methods.name: mergePermissions
methods.description: Merges permissions from a resource into an existing resource node.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a resource has unrestricted permissions for a given authorization context.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.description: Validates that permissions object is not null.

methods.name: createAbsoluteResourcePointer
methods.description: Creates a JsonPointer for a resource based on its ResourceKey.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjectIds
methods.description: Extracts subject IDs from an AuthorizationContext.

methods.name: visitTree
methods.description: Traverses the policy tree with a visitor pattern.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs with specific permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects with specific permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if any subject has partial permissions on a resource within an authorization context.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON view of a resource considering permissions and authorization context.

methods.name: getGrantedAndRevokedSubResource
methods.description: Determines granted and revoked sub-resources for a given resource and permissions.

methods.name: checkPermissionOnAnySubResource
methods.description: Checks permissions on any sub-resource of a given resource.

methods.name: traverseSubtreeForPermissionAccess
methods.description: Recursively traverses the resource subtree to check permission access.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds permission information to granted or revoked resource collections.

methods.name: collectFlatPointers
methods.description: Flattens nested JSON fields into a list of pointers and values.

methods.name: filterEntries
methods.description: Filters JSON entries based on granted and revoked resources.

methods.name: getPrefixPointerOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a prefix pointer at a specified level or throws if absent.

methods.name: containsPrefixPointer
methods.description: Checks if a collection of pointers contains a specific prefix.

methods.name: removeDeeperRevokes
methods.description: Removes revoke entries that are deeper in the resource hierarchy.

methods.name: retainElements
methods.description: Retains elements in one collection that are also present in another based on pointers.
